creation_policy.origin: New synthetic tasks authored from the user specification and corrected in response to private independent review; generic fictional situations with no personal or project identifiers.
creation_policy.isolation: No skill versions, development tasks, candidate outputs or grades, or other holdouts read. Corrections used only this holdout and its private independent review. Case text, original archive, and content-specific review notes remain private and excluded from optimizer and public context.
creation_policy.validation: Original independent content/specification review: FAIL, 28/30 pass and 2 requiring correction. Both corrected; revised author-side schema, source/assertion consistency, mathematical, and exact-arithmetic checks PASS for 30/30 cases and 150/150 assertions. Second independent review of the revised bytes is pending; no independent PASS is claimed. No candidate model or performance evaluation run.
creation_policy.reservation: Reserved sealed holdout, unrun for candidate performance. Private author and independent content reviews are validation only. No candidate generations, performance-grading runs, or Claude calls performed by this author; not released for current development grading.
